overviewParagraphs: Hoiana Shores Golf Club stands as one of the most significant golf openings in Southeast Asia in recent years. Designed by the legendary Robert Trent Jones Jr., it is the first course in Vietnam to sit directly on the East Sea, delivering a true links experience in a tropical setting.

The 18-hole layout winds through natural coastal dunes near the UNESCO World Heritage site of Hoi An, offering spectacular panoramic ocean views from nearly every hole. The course demands respect for the wind, rewarding players who think their way around rather than overpower it.

Part of the prestigious Hoiana integrated resort, the club features world-class clubhouse facilities, a luxury pro-shop, and a strategic practice facility. For discerning golfers seeking the authentic links challenge in an exotic location, Hoiana Shores is unmissable.
curatorBriefHtml: Hoiana Shores Golf Club is a premier Par 71 championship links layout in Hoi An, Vietnam, crafted by Robert Trent Jones Jr. (2019) and playing 6,554 Yards from the Blue Tees (7,004 yards from the Back Tips) across a coastal dunes environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its turf quality & pure links sand base (Zeon Zoysia • Firm, fast links roll) and strategic dunes routing & ocean drama (Robert Trent Jones II coastal design).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Hoiana Shores Golf Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie wind & contour reading (Experienced local caddies on subtle dunes), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Hoi An golf tour by AGS, Hoiana Shores Golf Club provides a distinct architectural test by Robert Trent Jones Jr. that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: A tour-de-force in modern links architecture. Robert Trent Jones Jr. sculpted a layout that directly hugs the East Sea dunes, demanding creative ground-game imagination in shifting afternoon sea breezes. Indisputably one of the top championship golf experiences in Asia.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Hoiana Shores Golf Club?
faqs.a: Hoiana Shores Golf Club in Hoi An, Vietnam is a Par 71 championship links layout designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr. (opened 2019), measuring 6,554 Yards from the Blue Tees (7,004 yards from the tips) within a coastal dunes setting. It is particularly noted for turf quality & pure links sand base (Zeon Zoysia • Firm, fast links roll).
